Board Members and presenters participate in regular public board meetings and other hearings remotely through Microsoft Teams. Members of the public can also participate via Microsoft Teams or listen to the meeting using the conference call phone number. Both meeting links and phone numbers are included in the agendas below.  All times listed are subject to change. Please check this page for the latest updates.

If you have an accessibility need to watch our public board meeting, please send an email to GMCB.Board@vermont.gov. 

Presenters in GMCB public board meetings are asked to review the Virtual Meeting Checklist prior to their presentations. 

The public can use our Public Meeting Participation Guide for additional meeting expectations and how to use Microsoft Teams. Members of the public who cannot access the public board meetings remotely can view the meeting in person at 112 State Street, 5th floor, in Montpelier, Vermont.  Please call (802) 828-2177 or email us at GMCB.Board@vermont.gov for additional location details. 

GMCB Board Meetings will also be scheduled on the Department of Libraries public meetings calendar. All Board Meetings are recorded and archived on our GMCB YouTube Channel. Transcripts from official hearings are available upon request. Please refer to our Public Records Information page to make a request.
